description: Submit a decision on a HIL approval. APPROVED resumes the crew past the gate; REJECTED sends it back. Approving a ship gate also merges its pull request once checks are green on the approved head when the gate says merge on approval (its initiative, program or company default); pass `autoMerge` to choose explicitly. Requires a key with the `approve` scope.

autoMerge.description: Ship gate approvals only: true merges the pull request once checks are green on the approved head; false approves without merging. Omit to use the gate's own setting (its autoMergeOnApproval). An initiative that leaves pull requests for human review is never merged.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional. Send the same key when retrying this exact call after a lost answer ("fetch failed"): the first call's result comes back and nothing is written twice. Reusing a key with different arguments is refused with idempotency_key_reused. 8-120 letters, digits, "_" or "-".

notes.description: Reviewer notes (shown in the audit trail). Required to reject an initiative plan: the plan goes back to the Architect with these notes as its instructions.

name: anyforge_submit_approval
title: Submit approval
